results.question: How does row level security work?
results.answer: Row Level Security (RLS) works by implementing granular authorization rules that run directly inside the Postgres database, securing your data at the row level [Source: https://supabase.com/features/row-level-security, Source: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security]. It controls access to individual rows based on user attributes or roles, combining grants and policies to determine access control [Source: https://supabase.com/features/row-level-security, Source: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security].

results.question: What is session replay?
results.answer: Session replay records what real users do in your product and plays it back like a DVR [Source: https://posthog.com/docs/session-replay]. It includes a synced DevTools panel that shows console logs, network requests, and errors at the exact moment they happened [Source: https://posthog.com/docs/session-replay].
